# How to connect your systeme.io account to ChatGPT using MCP keys

In this article, you will learn how to integrate the systeme.io MCP server with ChatGPT so you can interact with your account data using AI.

What you will need:

- A [systeme.io](https://help.systeme.io/article/systeme.io) account
- An MCP key generated from your systeme.io account ([How to use the systeme.io MCP server (Model Context Protoco](https://help.systeme.io/article/9489-how-to-use-systeme-ios-mcp#3-How-to-generate-your-MCP-keys-usC9d)l)
- A ChatGPT account

To connect [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) to ChatGPT using an MCP key, log in to your ChatGPT account, open the left side menu, and click **Plugins** (1).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-3c57sIe2ETddpwn1AKWwZ5BMRf68b9.png)

Click **Add** (2), and select **Add custom MCP server** (3).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-I9wxXVpo5gLmysf4kiAGIwUIaQwWRe.png)

In the setup popup, enter the following details:

- **Name (4):** [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) MCP
- **Description (optional) (5):** [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) official MCP server
- **Connection (6):** Server URL
- **Server URL (7):** [https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOUR_KEY](https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=YOUR_KEY)

> **Note:** Replace YOUR_KEY with the MCP key you created on your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.

- **Authentication (8):** No Authentication

Tick the **I understand and want to continue** box (9), then click **Create as a plugin** (10).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-S46C1QUGnXM4YgMlUf2NLKI1BoWGp6.png)

In the "Add [Systeme.io](http://Systeme.io) MCP server to ChatGPT" window, click **Connect systeme.io** (11).

![](https://zhvg1sxtlhvjnntb.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/uploads/image-egTJ2IvzrtrYuRaE78hiSDdMllh5DK.png)

Once connected and set up, start a new chat in ChatGPT and start using commands to interact with your [systeme.io](http://systeme.io) account.

> **Notes:**
>
> - some actions (like create/update/delete) may be restricted or require additional confirmation. See [ChatGPT permissions and action restrictions](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-developer-mode-and-mcp-apps-in-chatgpt-beta).
>
> - If the server fails to connect, ensure that:
> - Your MCP key is valid and not expired, and you correctly [provided it](https://developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server#authentication) to the server.
> - Developer Mode is active in your ChatGPT settings.

You can also connect your systeme.io account to ChatGPT using the direct app connection. If you prefer this option over a manual setup with MCP keys, follow this guide: [How to connect your systeme.io account to ChatGPT](https://help.systeme.io/article/11342-how-to-connect-your-systeme-io-account-to-chatgpt).
